skill.displayName: Shopee-选品决策专家 | 青虎AI

llm.summary: This skill is a coherent Shopee market-analysis workflow that uses disclosed Qinghu API calls, paid-tool consent, and local report export for its stated reporting purpose.

dimensions.detail: The skill uses a Qinghu bearer token from the user or environment and calls an external API; this is expected for the data service and is paired with instructions to obtain confirmation before tool use.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The inspected artifact is a single non-executable SKILL.md with no install scripts, background workers, or bundled code.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The trigger language is broad, but the artifact repeatedly frames the workflow as a major-project, heavy analysis and explicitly directs users to a lighter related skill for routine product picking.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill directs automatic local spreadsheet export for result arrays of 10 or more records, which is purpose-aligned for report delivery but should be understood as local file creation.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill’s capabilities match its purpose: it builds a multi-dimensional Shopee selection report using Qinghu data APIs for site, category, shop, product, keyword, and price analysis.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this if you want a full Shopee project-selection report and are comfortable providing or exposing a Qinghu API token, spending Qinghu credits after approval, and receiving generated local spreadsheet files containing market-analysis data. Use a narrower skill for simple product checks.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The broad trigger concern is partly valid, but the same artifact clearly limits the intended use to major Shopee project decisions and warns against using it for daily item picking.
[SQP-1] expected: The example triggers are open-ended, but they are examples for complete Shopee selection reports and are supported by the stated heavy-workflow warning and related-skill handoff guidance.
[SQP-2] expected: Automatic export is real: the skill tells the agent to export arrays of 10 or more records without asking again. This is proportionate to a full report workflow, but it creates local files users should expect.
